summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 4 new features work end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest passing (13 new tests for prompts, photo, premium + 18 regression). Frontend (390x844): welcome art loads, login works, Discover shows daily-prompt-card ('TONIGHT'S GENTLE PROMPT' + prompt text + Share button navigating to Messages), chat-prompt-chip appears when input empty and pre-fills input on tap then hides, profile-photo-button uploads a JPEG (button text becomes 'Change photo'), profile-premium-button navigates to /premium showing 'Subscribe — $5.99 / month', clicking subscribe navigates to checkout.stripe.com. A REAL Stripe test-mode checkout was completed with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 which redirected to /premium-success?session_id=..., backend confirmed is_premium=true (status endpoint & /auth/me both flip to true), repeated checkout for that user returns 409, premium-success-screen renders 'Welcome to Premium ✨' and (when signed in) shows 'Continue to my profile' button navigating to Profile where profile-premium-badge '✨ Premium member' and profile-premium-active are visible; /premium for a premium user renders premium-active-state with 'You're a Premium member' + 'Back to my profile'; /premium-cancel renders 'See Premium again'. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only carry-over issue is the pre-existing premium back button hit-area (already reported in iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 774 lines is nearing the 700-line guideline; consider splitting premium/photo helpers into modules in a future iteration.
Storage init uses a module-level singleton _storage_key with a 503 re-init fallback — reasonable, but not thread-safe if multiple workers race; acceptable for single-worker uvicorn.

/api/premium/confirm is intentionally unauthenticated (browser-facing after Stripe redirect); it only reveals payment status for a known session_id, which is acceptable but should be rate-limited in production.
/api/files/{path} serves photos publicly (by design). Emergent object storage acts as source of truth; DB acts as ACL gate — good.

PremiumSuccess only shows 'Continue to my profile' when signedIn=true (token exists). This is the correct behaviour but means users completing checkout in a different browser than the app won't see the button; the 'You can close this page…' hint is a reasonable fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-2 flows verified (welcome art, daily prompt on discover, share->messages, chat prompt chip, photo upload, unlock premium->stripe->success->profile badge, premium-active state, premium-cancel)
